cases.task: Choose the safe EventSource error-channel rule when the server needs to signal a terminal application failure but browsers also emit native error events for reconnectable transport failures.

required_facts.text: The native EventSource error event represents reconnectable transport failures and must not close the stream or invalidate its connection generation.
A terminal application failure must stop automatic reconnection and fence queued callbacks.
Using the reserved error event name for both meanings makes transient failures indistinguishable from terminal application failures.
